info.title: PRP - Private Management Contract
info.description: DRAFT machine-readable form of the management operation inventory in API-PRP §8. Management policies have one stable resource per kind and canonical scope, with create/read/update semantics. Deployment quota ceilings are operator configuration outside this API. Key rotation preserves grants and expiry, and quota windows use trailing rolling intervals. Formal WP03 freeze remains gated by WP01 evidence. Every mutation requires the approved role/action matrix and explicit scope, a current version (If-Match), an idempotent operation identity where retryable (Idempotency-Key), and produces a redacted audit event. Inference client keys never authorize these routes. No operation here may run a host reboot, kill or model load in response to a user inference request. Not implemented or tested.

x-prp-consumers: apps/console (operator UX over these routes only)

servers.description: Documentation placeholder. Management routes are reachable only through the approved private ingress / VPN (ARCH-PRP §4).

post.summary: Issue a scoped inference key for a principal or application
post.description: The first response contains the secret once. A replay with the same Idempotency-Key and canonical payload returns the stable receipt without plaintext; a different payload with the same key returns 409. If the first response was lost, revoke and reissue the key. PRP stores a verifier only (PRP-FR-005); no later call, export or backup can reveal the secret.

200.description: Idempotent replay; stable receipt returned without plaintext. If the first response was lost, revoke and reissue the key.

post.summary: Rotate a key; the new secret is shown once and the old verifier expires after bounded overlap
post.description: The optional overlap_seconds request field defaults to 86400 and may be reduced to 1..86400 seconds. Only active, unexpired keys may rotate. The new key inherits the old key's organization, subject, capabilities, model aliases, quota_policy_id, label, and exact expires_at; rotation never extends expiry or grants. The old verifier stops working at the earlier of its original expires_at and rotation time plus overlap_seconds; when expires_at is null, the overlap deadline applies. Use revoke for immediate terminal invalidation. A replay with the same Idempotency-Key and canonical payload returns the original stable issuance receipt without plaintext before rechecking If-Match or current-key eligibility; it never resurrects the old key, recreates a revoked new key, or restarts/extends overlap. A different canonical payload with that key, including a changed overlap_seconds, returns 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT. If the first response was lost, replay still cannot recover the secret; revoke and reissue the key.

get.summary: Read a quota or retention policy by canonical scope
get.description: Exactly one resource exists for each policy_kind and canonical scope. Omit both subject query fields for an organization policy; supply both to read a principal/application policy. The returned version is the current value for If-Match.

post.summary: Create a quota or retention policy for a canonical scope
post.description: Creates the unique resource for policy_kind and scope. Creation is idempotent by operator, route, and canonical payload. A different resource already occupying the scope returns 409 POLICY_EXISTS. The 201 MutationReceipt supplies the stable resource_id and initial opaque version; use the returned version in If-Match for later updates. A quota policy at principal/application scope must be created before issuing keys for that exact organization and subject; the key's quota_policy_id is this resource_id.

OperatorSession.name: prp_session
OperatorSession.description: Interactive console authentication with CSRF protection and secure cookie policy (API-PRP §2). It identifies the actor; role and object scope are resolved separately under the approved role/action matrix. No master or service key is ever exposed to browser JavaScript.

OperatorKey.description: Automation authentication only. The resolved actor record supplies explicit non-escalating role and scope under the approved role/action matrix; possession of this key does not itself grant a role. Distinct from inference client keys, which never authorize management routes.

resource_id.description: Stable policy identifier for createPolicy; other operations return their target resource identifier.

version.description: Opaque resource version to send unchanged as If-Match on the next mutation; on creation this is the initial version.

AccessGrantRequest.description: Inference capability grant within an organization; management permissions remain governed by OperatorSession or OperatorKey role and scope.

KeyRequest.description: Issues a client inference key bound to one organization and owning principal or application. Management permissions are not client-key capabilities.

model_aliases.description: Public PRP model aliases; vendor model IDs and physical pool IDs are not accepted.

quota_policy_id.description: Stable resource_id of the quota policy for this key's exact organization and owning subject. All keys for that subject share subject-scope quota counters; the organization policy is also enforced when present.

KeyRotationRequest.description: Optional overlap for the old verifier during rotation. Omitted body or field uses the 24-hour default; immediate invalidation uses the separate revoke operation.

overlap_seconds.description: Seconds the old verifier remains valid after rotation; callers may shorten but never exceed the 24-hour default maximum.

KeyIssued.description: Initial key issuance response. The secret is present only in this response and is never retained for replay.

secret.description: Shown once; never retrievable, exportable or restorable afterwards (PRP-FR-005)

key_prefix.description: Non-secret prefix for identification in logs and UI

quota_policy_id.description: Stable resource_id of this key's exact subject quota policy; all keys for that subject share its counters.

KeyIssuanceReplayReceipt.description: Stable idempotency replay receipt. The secret was not retained and cannot be recovered; revoke and reissue if the first response was lost.

key_prefix.description: Non-secret prefix for identification in logs and UI

secret_available.description: The plaintext secret is never retained and cannot be recovered after the first response.

KeyIssuanceResponse.description: The first successful response contains the plaintext secret; a replay contains only the stable receipt.

CapabilityGrant.description: Inference capabilities only. Management permissions are granted and checked separately through management authentication and roles.

origin.description: Allowed worker/adapter endpoint on the private network

physical_resource_id.description: host + GPU UUID, verified host-local identity or CPU pool (ARCH-PRP §5)

credential_ref.description: Reference to the service credential in the secret store; never the credential itself

NodeUpdate.description: Partial update; fields to freeze at G0. Capacity increases are gated by qualification.

license_receipt_ref.description: Reference to the recorded license / voice-rights receipt; not the document itself

PolicyWrite.description: Complete policy creation or replacement body. The settings variant must match the policy_kind path parameter. Scope is mandatory and must be within the authenticated actor's grant. Resources are unique by policy_kind and canonical scope: organization_id alone identifies an organization policy; organization_id plus subject_type and subject_id identifies a principal/application policy. Policy resources have no delete operation in this contract.

PolicyResource.description: Current policy representation. resource_id is stable for the lifetime of the canonical scope; version is an opaque token to send unchanged in If-Match. Policy resources are not deleted through this contract.

PolicyScope.description: Canonical identity is policy_kind plus organization_id and optional subject. Subject absence means one organization-wide policy; a subject means one principal/application policy within the organization.

QuotaPolicySettings.description: Complete quota policy. Each limit is enforced atomically; zero denies new use for that dimension. Organization and subject policies are both enforced when present; all keys for a subject share the subject policy counters. quota_policy_id binds a key to its exact subject policy and does not create a separate per-key counter. Deployment ceilings are enforced from operator-only deployment configuration outside this API.

storage_bytes.description: Maximum retained storage allowance in bytes.

WindowBudget.description: Maximum admitted units within any trailing rolling interval of window_seconds, using the admission authority's timestamp; the interval is (now - window_seconds, now], excluding events exactly at its lower boundary. Reservations count immediately; settlement replaces the reservation with actual usage at the original admission time. If actual usage exceeds its reservation, record the actual amount and deny later admissions until the interval permits them; unavailable actual usage retains the conservative reservation until it ages out. Admission and settlement are atomic across organization and subject policy counters.

limit.description: Maximum units admitted in any trailing interval of this duration; events exactly at the interval's lower boundary are excluded.

window_seconds.description: Length of the rolling interval in seconds.

RetentionPolicySettings.description: The fields below are the complete configurable retention policy. Defaults are descriptive unless a field explicitly states an upper bound; authorized deletion may shorten retention. This policy does not configure dedupe-record retention: dedupe records MUST remain available for at least the job horizon plus 24 hours (SRS PRP-FR-037 and §10).

async_payload_terminal_ttl_seconds.description: Retention after terminal state, at most 24 hours.

async_payload_max_age_seconds.description: Absolute payload age, at most 48 hours from creation.

raw_audio_max_age_seconds.description: Absolute raw/orphan audio age, at most 24 hours from upload.

generated_audio_retention_seconds.description: Default seven-day retention; authorized deletion may shorten it.

job_usage_audit_metadata_retention_days.description: Metadata retention in days; policy may shorten the 90-day default.

operational_log_retention_days.description: Default 30-day retention for redacted operational logs.

share_grant_max_ttl_seconds.description: Maximum share-grant TTL; actual expiry must also be no later than artifact expiry.

traffic_isolated.description: Operator attests that traffic is isolated (OPS-PRP RB07 step 1)

replay_erasure_ledger.description: Always true; erasure tombstones are applied before restored content is readable (ADR-PRP-007)
